cohort: This study included 24,303 women who delivered at or after 20 weeks of gestation at a single center between 2013 and 2018.
finding: Patients at the highest risk of obstetrical thromboembolism (those receiving outpatient heparin-based prophylaxis or treatment) had an 11-fold increased risk of thromboembolism and a 5-fold increased risk of postpartum wound and bleeding complications compared to low-risk patients.
gest_age: Deliveries at or after 20 weeks gestation
